title: Messerschmitt's 1952 interview with a French paper

tellings.quote: Messerschmitt in '52 gives this interview to this French paper and he says, "If you see UFOs in the sky, they're probably the ones that I designed and was built by, you know, the Habermohl project and, you know, Škoda Works under Hans Kammler.

plain: Michels says that in 1952 the German aircraft designer Messerschmitt told a French newspaper that UFOs seen in the sky were probably craft he had designed, built through a project linked to a man named Habermohl and at the Škoda Works factory under a man named Hans Kammler. Michels tells this himself, from that interview, as a possible earthly origin for some saucer sightings.
